articles.title: The UV-tracking Gem made me rethink how sunlight affects my health, not just my appearance
articles.essence: With temperatures rising to the 90s in Los Angeles, avoiding the heat wasn't exactly an option while I was at a relative's outdoor party in August. So I sat beneath a patio umbrella with a powerful fan nearby, figuring I was protected from the sun and heat.

articles.title: Costco members can get $5 off the reimagined Ocarina of Time
articles.essence: While some retailers were offering preorder discounts on the remastered Legend of Zelda: The Ocarina of Time, it’s not too late to save if you missed out. Costco members can currently get $5 off the digital version online, bringing the price down to $54.99.

articles.title: NYT Cooking’s AI assistant saved my weeknight chicken, but almost ruined my cake
articles.essence: Around 7PM each weeknight, I find myself standing in front of the fridge, trying to decide on something for dinner that won't make my husband complain, "Chicken again?" Yes, I should meal plan more, but I don't, so this is where I'm at. A nightly battle in which the chicken usually wins.
